title: Civil War Era Mac & Cheese
description: A simple, creamy macaroni and cheese inspired by Civil War recipes, cooked with canned milk and Parmesan cheese, seasoned with nutmeg and spices.

ingredients.item: Breadcrumbs or dried cornbread for topping (optional)

steps: Bring the canned evaporated milk to a simmer in a Dutch oven or large pot.
Add the pasta directly into the simmering milk, stirring constantly to prevent scorching.
Cook the pasta in the milk until tender and the milk has reduced by about half, approximately 15 minutes.
Stir in the butter until melted and incorporated.
Add the grated Parmesan cheese, stirring until the mixture is smooth and creamy.
Season with black pepper, nutmeg, and salt to taste.
Optional: Transfer to a greased casserole dish, sprinkle with breadcrumbs or dried cornbread, and dust with smoked paprika.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for about 15 minutes or until golden brown on top.
Serve hot and enjoy this traditional Civil War-inspired macaroni and cheese.
notes:
For added flavor, sprinkle with breadcrumbs and smoked paprika before baking.
